_comment: Single source of truth for the review cadence. Max days since lastReviewed before a page of each freshnessClass is OVERDUE, and the fraction of that window at which it becomes DUE SOON (so a review can be scheduled before it lapses, not after). Consumed by lib/content.ts (FRESHNESS_MAX_DAYS), lib/freshness.ts (the derived review state + the admin worklist) and scripts/freshness-audit.mjs. Change cadences here only - never in one consumer.
